theme_portfolio_projects.title: Codeware CMS & Store

theme_portfolio_projects.title: Versioned REST API
theme_portfolio_projects.description: A public, read-only API tier plus an admin CRUD tier behind Sanctum and a gate. Consistent {data, meta} envelopes, locale-aware resources and pagination.

theme_portfolio_projects.title: Multi-tenant SaaS starter
theme_portfolio_projects.description: Subscription billing, team workspaces, invitations and per-tenant data isolation, with queued emails and webhook handling.

theme_portfolio_projects.title: Headless storefront
theme_portfolio_projects.description: A Next.js front end consuming the Laravel API for catalogue, cart and checkout, with server-side rendering for SEO.

theme_portfolio_hero_tagline: I design and build Laravel applications that stay maintainable as they grow: clean architecture, versioned REST APIs, Livewire admin panels, queues and payments, shipped with tests and CI.
theme_portfolio_availability: Open to Laravel projects and full-time roles

theme_portfolio_experiences.description: Building Laravel applications from schema to deployment: Eloquent models and migrations, form requests and policies, queued jobs, Sanctum-secured APIs and Livewire admin panels. Every feature ships with Pest tests and a migration the next change can build on.

Designed the REST APIs and internal tools other teams depended on. Cut slow pages by fixing N+1 queries, adding the right indexes and caching with Redis, and treated clear validation errors as part of the API.
Custom themes, plugins and store migrations. That work is where I learned why Laravel structure matters: a codebase that grows one plugin at a time needs a shape it can keep growing in.

theme_portfolio_testimonials.quote: Our Laravel API was timing out under load. He found the N+1 queries, added the right indexes and put Redis caching in front, and response times dropped from seconds to milliseconds.
theme_portfolio_testimonials.name: Rafiq Hasan

theme_portfolio_testimonials.quote: Clean code, proper tests and a Livewire admin panel our team could use on day one. Every pull request came with a clear explanation, so handover was painless.
theme_portfolio_testimonials.name: Nusrat Jahan

theme_portfolio_testimonials.quote: He took our WooCommerce store and rebuilt it as a Laravel backend with a REST API. Deployment is automated now, and releases no longer feel risky.
theme_portfolio_testimonials.name: Tanvir Ahmed
